title: Augmented Lagrangian Method for Mathematical Programs with Second-Order Cone Complementarity Constraints
summary: This paper investigates mathematical programs with second-order cone complementarity constraints (SOCMPCCs), which extend classical mathematical programs with complementarity constraints (MPCCs) by incorporating second-order cone structures. SOCMPCCs present significant theoretical and computational challenges, primarily due to the failure of standard constraint qualifications (such as Robinson's constraint qualification) at all feasible points.
